time_expectation: Designed so that a correct solution (sequence export, Bloch simulation of about 1e4 isochromats, reconstruction and checks) fits within the 60-minute session on a shared CPU without GPU.
acquisition: 2D single-shot gradient-echo echo-planar imaging of the slice at z = 0: exactly one slice-selective 90 deg excitation (no other RF pulse), followed by an echo train with alternating readout polarity along x and phase-encode blips along y
flip_angle_definition: realized on-resonance flip angle 360 deg x |integral of the RF waveform (Hz) over time|, tolerance 2%; the RF pulse is played with a z gradient on and no x or y gradient, RF frequency offset 0
effective_echo_time_definition: from the centre of the excitation pulse to the instant at which the nominal k-space trajectory of the ky = 0 imaging echo crosses kx = 0; tolerance 10 us
echo_spacing_definition: interval between the kx = 0 crossings of consecutive imaging echoes; identical (within 1 us) for all consecutive imaging echoes and at most 0.40 ms

sampling_contract.adc_events: the last 24 ADC events of the sequence are the imaging echoes j = 0..23 in chronological order; any ADC events before them are reference/navigator echoes of your choice; every ADC event has the same number of samples
sampling_contract.phase_encoding: during every sample of imaging echo j: ky = (j-12)/fov_m within 0.05 cycles/m (no blip during an ADC window) and kz = 0 within 0.05 cycles/m
sampling_contract.readout_coverage: the nominal kx positions of the samples of every imaging echo must cover [-12/fov_m, +11/fov_m] with no gap between consecutive samples larger than 1/fov_m inside that interval (samples outside the interval are allowed); sample times are delay + (i+0.5) x dwell
sampling_contract.k_space_rule: nominal k-space positions are the time integrals of the exported gradients from the centre of the excitation pulse

gradient_delay_model: Real gradient chains lag the ADC. Hidden measurements are acquired with an unknown constant delay delta, |delta| <= 6 us, between all gradient waveforms and the ADC: the sample recorded at nominal time t has the k-space position k_nominal(t - delta). The simulator realises this by shifting every ADC sampling time by -delta. The public measurement you simulate has delta = 0. The reconstruction must work without being told delta, from the measurement archive alone.
image_quality_requirement: for each of the two hidden delayed measurements, the magnitude image from reconstruct.py must have a mean magnitude in background voxels at least 2 voxels away from the object below 8% of the median magnitude in the reference region, and must agree with the image reconstruct.py produces from the same object acquired with delta = 0 (normalized RMS difference after a least-squares scale at most 0.12); that delta = 0 image must agree with a reference reconstruction within 0.25

phantom.content: x_m [24] and y_m [24] in-plane voxel-centre coordinates (x_m[12] = y_m[12] = 0), z_offsets_m [31], and 24x24 [y,x] maps density, T1_s, T2_s, B0_Hz, labels
phantom.isochromat_model: the object is the outer product of the in-plane grid and z_offsets_m: every in-plane voxel with density > 0 is a column of 31 isochromats at (x_m[ix], y_m[iy], z_offsets_m[n]) spread uniformly over -6.75 mm < z < 6.75 mm, each with density/31 and the voxel's T1, T2 (T2 is the only transverse decay), B0 = 0; magnetization starts at thermal equilibrium; noise-free

endpoint: complex image on the 24x24 [y,x] grid; per vial, the median magnitude over the vial voxels not touching another label divided by the same quantity for label 1
bloch_simulation: simulate the exported sequence.seq file itself with an established Bloch simulator (KomaMRI is the reference implementation; MRzero is acceptable); do not replace it with your own Bloch or EPG code

simulation_output_schema.raw_signal: complex [n_adc, n_samples], all ADC events in chronological order (reference echoes first, then the 24 imaging echoes), after ADC phase demodulation; encoding exp(-2 pi i (kx x + ky y)); an arbitrary single global receiver phase is accepted
simulation_output_schema.kxy_cycles_per_m: float [n_adc, n_samples, 2] nominal k-space position [kx, ky] of every sample computed from the exported sequence
simulation_output_schema.adc_times_s: float [n_adc, n_samples] nominal absolute sample times
simulation_output_schema.is_navigator: bool [n_adc], true for the reference/navigator echoes
simulation_output_schema.phantom_sha256: SHA256 of the phantom file used
simulation_output_schema.other_keys: allowed; they are passed through unchanged to the hidden archives

reconstruct_cli: python reconstruct.py --input simulation.npz --output image.npz. Standalone: helper code inside this one file, installed third-party imports allowed; it must work in a clean directory containing only this file and the archive, using only the archive contents. It is rerun on archives with the same keys whose raw_signal comes from another object acquired with your sequence under an unknown gradient delay.

image_output_schema.image: complex [24,24] on the [y,x] grid of the phantom (row index increases with y, column with x), no flips or shifts

report_output_schema.realized_effective_echo_time_ms: float measured from the exported sequence
report_output_schema.realized_echo_spacing_ms: float measured from the exported sequence
report_output_schema.ghost_correction: string: what reference data the sequence acquires and how reconstruct.py uses it
report_output_schema.signal_ratio_by_label: object mapping "2".."6" to the endpoint ratio measured on your image

grading_note: The grader reads the exported sequence back, checks limits, rasters, the excitation, TE, echo spacing and the sampling contract, replays the file in KomaMRI on the public object and on a hidden object with delta = 0 and with two hidden nonzero delays, compares your simulated signal with the replay, and reruns reconstruct.py on the hidden measurements.
